下面这版只替换两处：截图函数 和 run() 主循环。
它做了这些优化：
1. fast path 命中：不截图、不调豆包 Vision2. UIA 能找到控件：直接 uia_click，不截图3. OCR 可命中文字：直接 click，不调 Vision4. 只有最后才调用豆包 Vision5. PNG 改 JPEG，默认活动窗口截图，最大宽度 1280，质量 606. pyautogui.PAUSE 从 0.3 降到 0.027. sleep 从固定 0.8 改成按动作类型短等待
你可以直接把下面两个函数替换进 computer_use.py。其中 call_doubao_vision(...)、execute_action(...)、uia_dump(...)、uia_click(...)、ocr(...) 如果你已有同名函数会直接用；没有的话会自动 fallback 到 desktop-action.ps1 / pyautogui。
Pythondef screenshot_jpeg_base64(active_window_only: bool = True, max_width: int = 1280, quality: int = 60) -> str: """ 替换旧 PNG 截图函数： - 默认只截活动窗口，减少图像面积 - JPEG 替代 PNG，3800KB 通常可降到 100~300KB - 限制最大宽度，进一步降低豆包 Vision 上传耗时 - 返回 base64 字符串 """ import base64 import ctypes import io import pyautogui class RECT(ctypes.Structure): _fields_ = [ ("left", ctypes.c_long), ("top", ctypes.c_long), ("right", ctypes.c_long), ("bottom", ctypes.c_long), ] def _active_window_rect(): try: user32 = ctypes.windll.user32 hwnd = user32.GetForegroundWindow() if not hwnd: return None rect = RECT() ok = user32.GetWindowRect(hwnd, ctypes.byref(rect)) if not ok: return None x = int(rect.left) y = int(rect.top) w = int(rect.right - rect.left) h = int(rect.bottom - rect.top) if w <= 50 or h <= 50: return None return (x, y, w, h) except Exception: return None region = _active_window_rect() if active_window_only else None if region: img = pyautogui.screenshot(region=region) else: img = pyautogui.screenshot() img = img.convert("RGB") w, h = img.size if w > max_width: ratio = max_width / float(w) img = img.resize((max_width, int(h * ratio))) buf = io.BytesIO() img.save(buf, format="JPEG", quality=quality, optimize=True) return base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode("ascii")def run(task: str, max_steps: int = 6): """ 优化版 computer_use.py 主循环。 执行顺序： 1. fast path：Win / 快捷键 / 打开应用 / 输入文本，直接执行 2. UIA：能读到控件并命中目标，直接 uia_click 3. OCR：本地 RapidOCR 命中文字，直接 click 4. Vision：最后兜底，才截图 + 调豆包 Vision 只改 run()，其他已有函数保持不动。 """ import json import os import re import subprocess import time import pyautogui # 原来 0.3 太慢 pyautogui.PAUSE = 0.02 if hasattr(pyautogui, "MINIMUM_DURATION"): pyautogui.MINIMUM_DURATION = 0 if hasattr(pyautogui, "MINIMUM_SLEEP"): pyautogui.MINIMUM_SLEEP = 0 DESKTOP_ACTION = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "desktop-action.ps1") started_at = time.perf_counter() last_error = None # ----------------------------- # Local adapters # ----------------------------- def _ps(*args, timeout=5): """ 调 desktop-action.ps1。 兼容： desktop-action.ps1 launch notepad desktop-action.ps1 hotkey ctrl+c desktop-action.ps1 type hello desktop-action.ps1 click 100 200 desktop-action.ps1 uia_dump desktop-action.ps1 uia_click xxx desktop-action.ps1 ocr """ if not os.path.exists(DESKTOP_ACTION): raise FileNotFoundError(f"desktop-action.ps1 not found: {DESKTOP_ACTION}") cmd = [ "powershell", "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", DESKTOP_ACTION, *[str(a) for a in args], ] p = subprocess.run( cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=timeout, ) if p.returncode != 0: raise RuntimeError((p.stderr or p.stdout or "").strip()) return (p.stdout or "").strip() def _has_global(name: str) -> bool: return callable(globals().get(name)) def _safe_sleep(action_type: str): """ 原来每步 sleep=0.8 太慢。 这里按动作类型短等待。 """ if action_type in {"launch", "open_app"}: time.sleep(0.35) elif action_type in {"hotkey", "press"}: time.sleep(0.12) elif action_type in {"click", "uia_click"}: time.sleep(0.15) elif action_type in {"type", "input"}: time.sleep(0.05) else: time.sleep(0.12) def _desktop_launch(app: str): try: _ps("launch", app, timeout=3) except Exception: subprocess.Popen(app, shell=True) _safe_sleep("launch") def _desktop_hotkey(*keys: str): combo = "+".join(keys) try: _ps("hotkey", combo, timeout=3) except Exception: pyautogui.hotkey(*keys) _safe_sleep("hotkey") def _desktop_press(key: str): try: _ps("hotkey", key, timeout=3) except Exception: pyautogui.press(key) _safe_sleep("press") def _desktop_type(text: str): try: _ps("type", text, timeout=5) except Exception: pyautogui.write(text, interval=0) _safe_sleep("type") def _desktop_click(x: int, y: int): try: _ps("click", x, y, timeout=3) except Exception: pyautogui.click(x, y) _safe_sleep("click") def _normalize_key(key: str) -> str: key = str(key).strip().lower() aliases = { "windows": "win", "cmd": "win", "return": "enter", "escape": "esc", "control": "ctrl", "delete": "del", "spacebar": "space", } return aliases.get(key, key) def _extract_quoted_text(s: str): """ 提取： 输入"hello" 输入 'hello' 输入：hello type hello """ patterns = [ r"[输入入打字type]+\s*[\"“](.*?)[\"”]", r"[输入入打字type]+\s*['‘](.*?)['’]", r"(?:输入|打字|type)\s*[:：]\s*(.+)$", r"^type\s+(.+)$", ] for pat in patterns: m = re.search(pat, s, re.I | re.S) if m: text = m.group(1).strip() if text: return text return None def _fast_path_once(user_task: str) -> bool: """ 命中则直接执行并返回 True。 不截图，不调豆包 Vision。 """ t = user_task.strip() tl = t.lower() # 1. Win / 开始菜单 if re.search(r"(按|打开|启动).*(win|windows|开始菜单|start menu)", tl): _desktop_press("win") return True # 2. 常见快捷键 hotkeys = [ (r"(复制|copy|ctrl\+c)", ("ctrl", "c")), (r"(粘贴|paste|ctrl\+v)", ("ctrl", "v")), (r"(全选|select all|ctrl\+a)", ("ctrl", "a")), (r"(保存|save|ctrl\+s)", ("ctrl", "s")), (r"(撤销|undo|ctrl\+z)", ("ctrl", "z")), (r"(重做|redo|ctrl\+y)", ("ctrl", "y")), (r"(关闭窗口|alt\+f4)", ("alt", "f4")), (r"(任务管理器|task manager|ctrl\+shift\+esc)", ("ctrl", "shift", "esc")), ] for pat, keys in hotkeys: if re.search(pat, tl): _desktop_hotkey(*keys) return True # 3. 显式 ctrl+x / alt+tab / win+r 这种 m = re.search(r"\b(ctrl|alt|shift|win)\s*\+\s*([a-z0-9]+|f[1-9][0-2]?)\b", tl) if m: _desktop_hotkey(_normalize_key(m.group(1)), _normalize_key(m.group(2))) return True # 4. 打开应用 app_map = { "记事本": "notepad", "notepad": "notepad", "计算器": "calc", "calculator": "calc", "画图": "mspaint", "paint": "mspaint", "资源管理器": "explorer", "文件管理器": "explorer", "explorer": "explorer", "cmd": "cmd", "命令提示符": "cmd", "powershell": "powershell", "terminal": "wt", "终端": "wt", "设置": "ms-settings:", "settings": "ms-settings:", } opened = False for name, app in app_map.items(): if re.search(rf"(打开|启动|运行|open|launch).{{0,10}}{re.escape(name)}", tl): _desktop_launch(app) opened = True break # 5. “打开记事本并输入 xxx” 这种合并任务 text = _extract_quoted_text(t) if text: if opened: time.sleep(0.15) _desktop_type(text) return True if opened: return True # 6. 纯输入 if text: _desktop_type(text) return True return False def _read_uia(): """ 优先用已有 uia_dump()。 没有就调用 desktop-action.ps1 uia_dump。 返回 list[dict] 或原始文本。 """ if _has_global("uia_dump"): return globals()["uia_dump"]() try: out = _ps("uia_dump", timeout=3) if not out: return None try: return json.loads(out) except Exception: return out except Exception: return None def _uia_elements(uia): """ 兼容几种格式： {"elements": [...]} [...] "raw text" """ if not uia: return [] if isinstance(uia, dict): if isinstance(uia.get("elements"), list): return uia["elements"] if isinstance(uia.get("controls"), list): return uia["controls"] if isinstance(uia, list): return uia return [] def _extract_click_target(user_task: str): """ 提取“点击/打开/选择 XXX”的目标文本。 """ patterns = [ r"(?:点击|点|选择|打开|press|click|select)\s*[\"“](.*?)[\"”]", r"(?:点击|点|选择|打开|press|click|select)\s*['‘](.*?)['’]", r"(?:点击|点|选择|打开)\s*[:：]\s*(.+)$", r"(?:点击|点|选择|打开)\s+(.+)$", r"(?:click|select|press)\s+(.+)$", ] for pat in patterns: m = re.search(pat, user_task, re.I | re.S) if m: target = m.group(1).strip() target = re.sub(r"[。.!！]$", "", target).strip() if target: return target return None def _uia_try_click(user_task: str, uia) -> bool: """ UIA 能读到控件时，优先直接点击，不截图。 """ target = _extract_click_target(user_task) if not target: return False target_l = target.lower() elements = _uia_elements(uia) best = None best_score = 0 for idx, e in enumerate(elements): if not isinstance(e, dict): continue name = str(e.get("name") or e.get("text") or e.get("title") or "").strip() ctype = str(e.get("control_type") or e.get("type") or "").strip() aid = str(e.get("automation_id") or e.get("auto_id") or "").strip() haystack = " ".join([name, ctype, aid]).lower() if not haystack: continue score = 0 if target_l == name.lower(): score += 100 elif target_l in name.lower(): score += 70 elif target_l in haystack: score += 40 if ctype.lower() in {"button", "menuitem", "listitem", "tabitem", "hyperlink"}: score += 10 if score > best_score: best_score = score best = (idx, e) if not best or best_score < 40: return False _, elem = best # 优先用已有 uia_click try: if _has_global("uia_click"): globals()["uia_click"](elem) _safe_sleep("uia_click") return True except Exception: pass # 其次用 desktop-action.ps1 uia_click target try: _ps("uia_click", target, timeout=4) _safe_sleep("uia_click") return True except Exception: pass # 最后用 rect 中心点点击 rect = elem.get("rect") or elem.get("bounds") or elem.get("rectangle") if isinstance(rect, dict): left = rect.get("left") top = rect.get("top") right = rect.get("right") bottom = rect.get("bottom") if None not in (left, top, right, bottom): x = int((left + right) / 2) y = int((top + bottom) / 2) _desktop_click(x, y) return True if isinstance(rect, (list, tuple)) and len(rect) >= 4: x = int((rect[0] + rect[2]) / 2) y = int((rect[1] + rect[3]) / 2) _desktop_click(x, y) return True return False def _ocr_try_click(user_task: str) -> bool: """ UIA 失败后，OCR 本地 22ms，优先于 Vision。 """ target = _extract_click_target(user_task) if not target: return False target_l = target.lower() try: if _has_global("ocr"): result = globals()["ocr"]() else: out = _ps("ocr", timeout=4) try: result = json.loads(out) except Exception: result = out except Exception: return False if not result: return False items = result if isinstance(result, dict): items = result.get("items") or result.get("results") or result.get("texts") or [] if isinstance(items, str): return False best = None best_score = 0 for item in items: if not isinstance(item, dict): continue text = str(item.get("text") or item.get("value") or "").strip() if not text: continue score = 0 if target_l == text.lower(): score = 100 elif target_l in text.lower(): score = 70 elif text.lower() in target_l: score = 50 if score > best_score: best_score = score best = item if not best or best_score < 50: return False center = best.get("center") if isinstance(center, (list, tuple)) and len(center) >= 2: _desktop_click(int(center[0]), int(center[1])) return True box = best.get("box") or best.get("bbox") or best.get("bounds") if isinstance(box, (list, tuple)): # RapidOCR 常见格式：[[x1,y1],[x2,y2],[x3,y3],[x4,y4]] if len(box) == 4 and all(isinstance(p, (list, tuple)) for p in box): xs = [float(p[0]) for p in box] ys = [float(p[1]) for p in box] _desktop_click(int(sum(xs) / len(xs)), int(sum(ys) / len(ys))) return True # 也兼容 [left, top, right, bottom] if len(box) >= 4 and all(isinstance(v, (int, float)) for v in box[:4]): x = int((box[0] + box[2]) / 2) y = int((box[1] + box[3]) / 2) _desktop_click(x, y) return True return False def _call_vision(user_task: str, uia=None): """ 最后的兜底： - 活动窗口 JPEG - 如果失败再全屏 JPEG - 兼容你已有的 call_doubao_vision / doubao_vision / vision_plan """ image_b64 = screenshot_jpeg_base64(active_window_only=True, max_width=1280, quality=60) payload = { "task": user_task, "image_base64": image_b64, "uia": uia, "instruction": ( "只返回 JSON。动作名只能是 click/type/press/hotkey/scroll/wait/done。" "如果可以批量完成，返回 actions 数组。" ), } for fn_name in ("call_doubao_vision", "doubao_vision", "vision_plan", "analyze_screenshot"): fn = globals().get(fn_name) if callable(fn): try: return fn(payload) except TypeError: try: return fn(user_task, image_b64) except TypeError: return fn(image_b64, user_task) raise RuntimeError("No vision function found: expected call_doubao_vision/doubao_vision/vision_plan/analyze_screenshot") def _normalize_actions(result): """ 兼容豆包返回： {"action": {...}} {"actions": [...]} [...] {"type": "click", ...} 同时修正 key/press_key/press 混用。 """ if result is None: return [] if isinstance(result, str): try: result = json.loads(result) except Exception: return [] if isinstance(result, list): raw_actions = result elif isinstance(result, dict) and isinstance(result.get("actions"), list): raw_actions = result["actions"] elif isinstance(result, dict) and isinstance(result.get("action"), dict): raw_actions = [result["action"]] elif isinstance(result, dict) and result.get("type"): raw_actions = [result] else: return [] aliases = { "key": "press", "press_key": "press", "keypress": "press", "keyboard": "press", "input": "type", "write": "type", "type_text": "type", "left_click": "click", "mouse_click": "click", "shortcut": "hotkey", "combo": "hotkey", "sleep": "wait", "finish": "done", "complete": "done", } actions = [] for a in raw_actions[:5]: if not isinstance(a, dict): continue t = str(a.get("type") or a.get("action") or "").strip().lower() t = aliases.get(t, t) a["type"] = t if t == "press": key = a.get("key") or a.get("value") or a.get("button") if key: a["key"] = _normalize_key(key) if t == "hotkey": keys = a.get("keys") or a.get("key") or a.get("combo") or a.get("shortcut") if isinstance(keys, str): if "+" in keys: keys = keys.split("+") elif "," in keys: keys = keys.split(",") else: keys = [keys] if isinstance(keys, list): a["keys"] = [_normalize_key(k) for k in keys] actions.append(a) return actions def _execute_actions(actions): """ 优先用已有 execute_action。 没有则本地执行常见动作。 """ for a in actions: t = a.get("type") if t == "done": return "done" if _has_global("execute_action"): globals()["execute_action"](a) _safe_sleep(t or "") continue if t == "click": x = a.get("x") y = a.get("y") if x is None or y is None: point = a.get("point") or a.get("position") if isinstance(point, (list, tuple)) and len(point) >= 2: x, y = point[0], point[1] elif isinstance(point, dict): x, y = point.get("x"), point.get("y") if x is None or y is None: raise ValueError(f"click missing x/y: {a}") _desktop_click(int(x), int(y)) elif t == "type": text = a.get("text") or a.get("value") or a.get("content") if text is None: raise ValueError(f"type missing text: {a}") _desktop_type(str(text)) elif t == "press": key = a.get("key") if not key: raise ValueError(f"press missing key: {a}") _desktop_press(str(key)) elif t == "hotkey": keys = a.get("keys") if not keys: raise ValueError(f"hotkey missing keys: {a}") _desktop_hotkey(*[str(k) for k in keys]) elif t == "scroll": amount = int(a.get("amount") or a.get("delta") or -5) pyautogui.scroll(amount) _safe_sleep("scroll") elif t == "wait": time.sleep(float(a.get("seconds") or a.get("duration") or 0.2)) else: raise ValueError(f"unknown action type: {a}") return None # ----------------------------- # Main loop # ----------------------------- # Step 0: fast path，开记事本/按 Win/快捷键/输入文本应在 <500ms~1s 内完成 try: if _fast_path_once(task): elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started_at print(f"[done] fast_path {elapsed:.3f}s") return { "ok": True, "mode": "fast_path", "elapsed": elapsed, } except Exception as e: last_error = f"fast_path_failed: {e}" print(f"[warn] {last_error}") for step in range(1, max_steps + 1): step_started = time.perf_counter() # 1. UIA first：能读控件就不要截图 uia = None try: uia = _read_uia() if uia and _uia_try_click(task, uia): elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started_at print(f"[done] uia_click step={step} elapsed={elapsed:.3f}s") return { "ok": True, "mode": "uia", "elapsed": elapsed, } except Exception as e: last_error = f"uia_failed: {e}" print(f"[warn] {last_error}") # 2. OCR second：22ms 本地 OCR，仍然不要 Vision try: if _ocr_try_click(task): elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started_at print(f"[done] ocr_click step={step} elapsed={elapsed:.3f}s") return { "ok": True, "mode": "ocr", "elapsed": elapsed, } except Exception as e: last_error = f"ocr_failed: {e}" print(f"[warn] {last_error}") # 3. Vision fallback：最后才截图 + 豆包 try: result = _call_vision(task, uia=uia) actions = _normalize_actions(result) if not actions: last_error = "vision_returned_no_actions" print(f"[warn] {last_error}") continue status = _execute_actions(actions) if status == "done" or any(a.get("type") == "done" for a in actions): elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started_at print(f"[done] vision_done step={step} elapsed={elapsed:.3f}s") return { "ok": True, "mode": "vision", "elapsed": elapsed, } # 执行动作后不要固定 sleep 0.8，只短等 step_elapsed = time.perf_counter() - step_started print(f"[step {step}] vision_action elapsed={step_elapsed:.3f}s") # 执行过动作后，下一轮先重新走 UIA/OCR，不立即再次 Vision continue except Exception as e: last_error = f"vision_failed: {e}" print(f"[error] {last_error}") break elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started_at print(f"[fail] max_steps={max_steps} elapsed={elapsed:.3f}s last_error={last_error}") return { "ok": False, "mode": "failed", "elapsed": elapsed, "last_error": last_error, }
建议你把旧调用里的：
Pythonscreenshot_png_base64()
替换为：
Pythonscreenshot_jpeg_base64(active_window_only=True, max_width=1280, quality=60)
这样“打开记事本”这类任务会直接命中：
desktop-action.ps1 launch notepad
不会再走：
全屏 PNG → 豆包 Vision → sleep 0.8 → 循环
预期效果：
打开记事本：10s → 0.5~1.0s按 Win：3s+ → 0.1~0.3s输入文本：3s+ → 0.1~0.5sUIA 点击按钮：3s+ → 0.3~0.8s只有真正需要视觉理解时才是 2.4s+
